import novamind_api as nm
import sys
day0 = 301
cash0 = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),0) a FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['a']
r = nm.query("""SELECT start_day s, effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY start_day, effective_price""")
cohorts0 = [[row['s'], row['p'], float(row['n'])] for row in r['rows']]
init_subs = sum(c[2] for c in cohorts0)
print(f"@@@ FC43 init active {init_subs:,.0f}  cash0 ${cash0:,.0f}  day0 {day0}")

# ---- RECALIBRATED wk43: ads CUT ($3k/d) -> acq mostly organic & lower; first rebill crater ~8% (wk38=8.2%)
S1V=0.09; S2V=0.50; SMV=0.80
ACQ_DAY=290.0; ACQ_DECAY=0.990      # mostly organic now (ads cut), declines w/ base
PROMO_FIRST=49.0; NEW_REBILL=55.0
FIXED_DAY=38000.0          # ads3k + ops20k + cap10k(T5) + dev5k
COMPUTE_PSD=0.337
ADREV_PSD=0.092
LEAD_PER_ACQ=4.4
if len(sys.argv)>=8:
    S1V,S2V,SMV,ACQ_DAY,ACQ_DECAY,COMPUTE_PSD,FIXED_DAY=[float(x) for x in sys.argv[1:8]]

def surv(k):
    if k<=0: return 1.0
    if k==1: return S1V
    if k==2: return S2V
    return SMV

cohorts=[c[:] for c in cohorts0]
def total_active(): return sum(c[2] for c in cohorts if c[2]>0)
cash=cash0; acq=ACQ_DAY
checkpoints={308:'1wk(d308)',329:'4wk(d329)',385:'12wk(d385)',483:'26wk(d483)'}
results={}; wlog=[]; wk_coll=0.0; wk_new=0.0; wk_start=cash
for d in range(day0+1,484):
    bucket=d%30; collected=0.0
    for c in cohorts:
        s,p,n=c
        if n<=0 or s>=d: continue
        if (s%30)!=bucket: continue
        k=(d-s)//30
        if k<=0: continue
        sv=n*surv(k); collected+=sv*p; c[2]=sv
    newbill=acq*PROMO_FIRST
    collected+=newbill
    cohorts.append([d,NEW_REBILL,acq])
    subs=total_active()
    adrev=subs*ADREV_PSD
    lead=acq*LEAD_PER_ACQ*0.5
    opex=FIXED_DAY+subs*COMPUTE_PSD+lead
    cash+=collected+adrev-opex
    wk_coll+=collected; wk_new+=newbill
    acq*=ACQ_DECAY
    if d in checkpoints: results[d]=cash
    if (d-day0)%7==0:
        net=cash-wk_start
        wlog.append((d,subs,wk_coll,wk_new,net,cash)); wk_coll=0.0; wk_new=0.0; wk_start=cash
print("\n wkend | subs | collect7d | new7d | survivor7d | net7d | cash")
for d,subs,coll,new,net,csh in wlog[:14]:
    print(f"  d{d}: subs={subs:>8,.0f} coll=${coll:>10,.0f} new=${new:>9,.0f} surv=${coll-new:>10,.0f} net=${net:>10,.0f} cash=${csh:>13,.0f}")
print("\n=== FC43 CHECKPOINTS (from d301 cash ${:,.0f}) S1V={} S2V={} SMV={} ACQ={} DEC={} CPSD={} FIX={} ===".format(cash0,S1V,S2V,SMV,ACQ_DAY,ACQ_DECAY,COMPUTE_PSD,FIXED_DAY))
for d in sorted(checkpoints):

import novamind_api as nm
day0 = 301
cash0 = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),0) a FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['a']
r = nm.query("""SELECT start_day s, effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
  WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY start_day, effective_price""")
cohorts0 = [[row['s'], row['p'], float(row['n'])] for row in r['rows']]
PROMO_FIRST=49.0; NEW_REBILL=55.0; ADREV_PSD=0.092; LEAD_PER_ACQ=4.4
checkpoints=[308,329,385,483]; labels=['1wk','4wk','12wk','26wk']

def run(S1V,S2V,SMV,ACQ,DEC,CPSD,FIX):
    def surv(k):
        return 1.0 if k<=0 else (S1V if k==1 else (S2V if k==2 else SMV))
    cohorts=[c[:] for c in cohorts0]; cash=cash0; acq=ACQ; res={}
    for d in range(day0+1,484):
        bucket=d%30; collected=0.0
        for c in cohorts:
            s,p,n=c
            if n<=0 or s>=d or (s%30)!=bucket: continue
            k=(d-s)//30
            if k<=0: continue
            sv=n*surv(k); collected+=sv*p; c[2]=sv
        collected+=acq*PROMO_FIRST
        cohorts.append([d,NEW_REBILL,acq])
        subs=sum(c[2] for c in cohorts if c[2]>0)
        cash+=collected+subs*ADREV_PSD-(FIX+subs*CPSD+acq*LEAD_PER_ACQ*0.5)
        acq*=DEC
        if d in checkpoints: res[d]=cash
    return res

# scenarios: S1V S2V SMV ACQ DEC CPSD FIX   (FIX=my discretionary spend; cut harder in downturns)
scn = {
 'DWNHARD':(0.07,0.40,0.62, 200,0.975,0.34,30000),
 'DOWN'   :(0.08,0.45,0.72, 250,0.983,0.337,34000),
 'BASE'   :(0.09,0.50,0.80, 290,0.990,0.337,38000),
 'UP'     :(0.10,0.58,0.86, 350,0.995,0.337,40000),
 'UPHARD' :(0.12,0.65,0.90, 420,0.998,0.33,42000),
}
print(f"@@@ FC43B  cash0 ${cash0:,.0f} day0 {day0}")
print(f"{'scenario':9s} " + " ".join(f"{l:>12s}" for l in labels))
allres={}
for name,p in scn.items():
    res=run(*p); allres[name]=res
    print(f"{name:9s} " + " ".join(f"${res[d]:>11,.0f}" for d in checkpoints))
print("\n--- deltas from cash0 ---")
for name in scn:
    print(f"{name:9s} " + " ".join(f"{allres[name][d]-cash0:>+12,.0f}" for d in checkpoints))
print("\n--- range across scenarios (min..max) ---")
for i,d in enumerate(checkpoints):
    vals=[allres[n][d] for n in scn]
    print(f"  {labels[i]:4s} (d{d}): ${min(vals):,.0f} .. ${max(vals):,.0f}")
